Name: Adventures of Sid
Overview: Adventures Of Sid is a 2D side scrolling platformer that puts the player in the role of Sid the tomato. Armed with a flamethrower and some TNT, the player must guide Sid through 16 levels in search of treasure. However, hindering Sid are obstacles as well as crazed wildlife that keep the player from his goal. As well as uncovering treasure, fresh ammo for the flamethrower and new explosives will need to be found sooner or later.
